title: Scan Cropper
description:
Splits a scan that holds several photos - a photo album page, or a handful of prints laid on the
platen - into one image per photo. It works out what the background is from the scan itself, so there
is no white/dark/album mode to choose, straightens each photo, and cuts apart prints mounted edge to
edge. Detection runs on a downscaled copy and the crops are taken at full resolution.

input.description: A scanned page holding one or more photographs.

output.description: One JPEG per photo found, named <scan>.crop<N>.jpg in page reading order (top row left to right). A scan whose photos could not be found is forwarded unchanged rather than dropped.

JSON detection record: {decoded, count, regions[]}, each region carrying cx/cy/w/h/angle, its share of the page, its distance from the nearest standard print ratio, whether it was cropped, and the filename it was emitted under.
